exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Unsecured Credentials
exploitedBy.relevance: Directly addresses the risk of credentials and secrets stored in plaintext without proper protection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Credentials In Files
exploitedBy.relevance: Specifically covers plaintext secrets stored in files, which is the core concern of this vector.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Private Keys
exploitedBy.relevance: Covers private keys stored insecurely in plaintext, a common form of plaintext secret storage.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Encrypted/Encoded File
exploitedBy.relevance: Relates to how inconsistent data classification can lead to improper handling of files that should be encrypted or labeled sensitive.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File and Directory Permissions Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Directly relates to filesystem permission issues, covering modification and abuse of file/directory permissions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Setuid and Setgid
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessive filesystem permissions via setuid/setgid bits are a classic privilege escalation risk tied to this vector.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Linux and Mac File and Directory Permissions Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Specifically addresses Linux/Mac filesystem permission abuse, highly relevant to excessive filesystem permission concerns.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Undefined retention policies mean files are not deleted on schedule, and attackers can exploit or manipulate retained files.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Destruction
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate disposal procedures can lead to improper data destruction, leaving sensitive data recoverable.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Inhibit System Recovery
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate disposal may leave recovery paths intact, and this technique covers the manipulation of system recovery mechanisms.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Remote Data Staging
exploitedBy.relevance: Copying configuration data across environments mirrors remote data staging behavior used to exfiltrate or leak sensitive data.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Environmental Keying
exploitedBy.relevance: Directly relevant as attackers or misconfigurations may exploit environment-specific keys when configs are copied between environments.
